mechanism: Infliximab (TNF-α inhibitor) increases infection risk and may impair immune response, while gentamicin nephrotoxicity risk is elevated in immunocompromised patients; concurrent use increases susceptibility to serious infections and gentamicin-induced acute kidney injury.
action: Monitor renal function closely, ensure adequate hydration, consider alternative antibiotics if possible, and assess for signs of infection; use gentamicin only when clearly indicated and at lowest effective dose.
